a: विहन् — {c2c} P. 1 To kill, slay, destroy, destroy completely, annihilate; (अलं) सहसा संहतिमंहसां विहंतुं Ki. 5. 17, 14. 23. --2 To strike, beat violently. --3 To obstruct, impede, oppose, resist; विघ्नांति रक्षांसि वने क्रतूंश्च Bk. 1. 19; Śi. 14. 8, R. 5. 27. --4 To reject, refuse, decline; तद्भूतनाथानुग नार्हसि त्वं संबंधिनो मे प्रणयं विहंतुं R. 2. 58; न व्यहन्यत कदाचिदर्थिता 11. 2. --5 To disappoint, foil, frustrate. --6 To separate.

v: na॰ vihanyate vi + hana--lyuw । 1 tulapiYjule 2 viGnaM 3 hiMsAyAYca medi॰ ।
m: वि-˚हनन n. (only L.) killing, slaying
hurting, injury
opposition, obstruction
a bow-like instrument for carding cotton.
a: विहननं — 1 Killing, striking. --2 Hurt, injury. --3 Obstruction, obstacle, impediment. --4 A bow for cleaning cotton.

m: वि-˚हन्तव्य mfn. to be destroyed, Prab.
वि-˚हन्तृ mfn. one who destroys or frustrates or disappoints (with gen. or ifc.), RV.; Up.

s: puM, (vi + hf + ap .) viyogaH । iti halAyuDaH ॥
v: pu॰ vi + hf--ap । vihAre lyuw । viharaRa tatrEva na॰ ।
m: वि-हर &c. See वि-√ हृ, col. 2.
वि-हर m. taking away, removing, shifting, changing, Bhartṛ.
separation, disunion, absence, W.
a: विहरः — 1 Taking away, removing. --2 Separation, disunion. --3 Changing.

m: वि-˚हरणीय mfn. to be taken away, W.
to be rambled or sported, ib.

s: klI, vihAraH । vipUrvvakahfDAtoranawpratyayena nizpannamidam ॥ (yaTA, BAgavate । 10 । 31 । 10 । “viharaRaYca te DyAnamaNgalam ॥” prasAraRam । yaTA, pARinO । 1 । 3 । 20 । “ANo do'nAsyaviharaRe ॥” AharaRam । yaTA, mArkaRqeye । 16 । 37 । “nAgniviharaRaYcEva kratvaBAvaSca lakzyate । navApyAyanamasmAkaM vinA homena jAyate ॥”)
m: वि-˚हरण n. the act of taking away or removing or changing or transposing, Lāṭy.; MārkP.
opening, expanding, Pāṇ. i, 3, 20
stepping out, ib. i, 3, 41
going about for pleasure or exercise, roaming, strolling, Kāv.; Pur.; Suśr.
taking out for a walk or for airing, Gobh.
moving to and fro, brandishing, MBh.
a: विहरणं — 1 Removing, taking away. --2 Taking a walk, airing, going about or rambling for pleasure. --3 Pleasure, pastime.

m: वि-˚हर्तृ m. one who takes away, a robber, Yājñ.; MBh.
one who rambles about or enjoys himself, Ragh.
a: विहर्तृ — m. 1 A roamer. --2 A robber.

m: वि-√ हर्य् P. -हर्यति, to scorn, repudiate, Nir. vii, 17 (cf. अ-विहर्यत-क्रतु).
1. वि—हर्ष m. excessive joy or gladness, MW.
2. वि—हर्ष mfn. joyless, sad, BhP.
वि-हर्ष , वि-हस्त &c. See p. 953, col. 2.
a: विहर्षः — Great joy, rapture.

m: वि-√ हस् P. -हसति, to laugh loudly, burst out laughing, MBh.; Kāv. &c.; to laugh at (acc., rarely gen.), Kāv.; BhP.; Pañcat.
a: विहस् — {c1c} P. 1 To smile, laugh gently; किंचिद्विहस्यार्थपतिं बभाषे R. 2. 46. --2 To laugh at, deride, ridicule; किमिति विषीदसि रोदीषि विकला विहसति युवतिसभा तव विकला Gīt. 9; गौरीवक्त्रभ्रुकुटिरचनां या विहस्येव फेनैः Me. 50.

m: वि-˚हसन n. id., W.
a: विहसनं, विहसितं, विहासः — A gentle laugh, smile.

m: वि-हसतिका f. gentle laughter, smiling, Hcar. (v.l. ˚सितिका).
वि-˚हसित mfn. laughing, smiling, Hariv.; Caurap.
laughed, smiled at, Kathās.
वि-˚हसित n. laughter, laughing, smiling, Kāv.; Sāh.

k.v: मध्यमः स्याद्विहसितं रोमाञ्चो रोमहर्षणम्. क्रन्दितं रुदितङ्क्रुष्टं जृम्भस्तु त्रिषु जृम्भणम्.।

m: वि-˚हसितिका See ˚हसतिका.

s: tri, vyAkulaH । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, raGuH । 5 । 49 । “rAmAparitrARavihastayoDaM senAniveSaM tumulaM cakAra ॥”) paRqitaH । iti medinI ॥ (yaTA, harivaMSe । 237 । 28 । “nAnAyuDavihastAnAM tvaritAnAM praDAvatAm । kzveqitotkruzwaninadErgajabfMhitanisvanEH ॥”) vikaraH । (yaTA, viKyAtavijaye । 2 aNke । “vigataraTavihastanyastaSastrapramattasKalitagatiBayArttAn nEva jAtu praharttA ॥”) paRqe, puM । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
v: tri॰ vigato hasto hastAvalambanaM yasya । 1 vyAkale amaraH । 2 paRqite medi॰ 3 paRqe ca pu॰ Sabdaca॰ । prA॰ 6 ba॰ । 4 hastaSUnye tri॰ ।
m: वि—हस्त mfn. without a hand or trunk, handless, Naiṣ. (-ता f., Śiś.)
unhandy, inexperienced (see अ-विह्˚)
confounded, perplexed, helpless, Kād.; Naiṣ. (-ता f., Śiś.; Hcar.)
(ifc.) completely absorbed in Ragh.
adroit, skilled, experienced (in; comp.), Hariv.
wise, learned, W.
वि—हस्त m. a eunuch, L.
a: विहस्त — a. 1 Handless. --2 Confounded, bewildered overpowered, made powerless; मालतीमुखावलोकनविहस्ततया Māl. 1, R. 5. 49. --3 Disabled, incapacitated (for doing the proper work); रुजाविहस्तचरणं M. 4. --4 Learned, wise.

k.v: आक्षारितः क्षारितोऽभिशस्ते सङ्कसुकोऽस्थिरे। व्यसनार्तोपरक्तौ द्वौ विहस्तव्याकुलौ समौ॥

m: वि—हस्त—ता f., Śiś.
वि—हस्त—ता f., Śiś.; Hcar.
वि—हस्तित mfn. confused, embarrassed, Kathās.
विहत् f. = वेहत्, L.

s: tri, viSezeRa hataH । vinazwaH । vipUrvvakahanaDAtoH ktapratyayena nizpannamidam ॥
m: वि-हत mfn. torn up, furrowed, TBr.; ŚBr.
struck or beaten away or dashed out (of a person's hand), BhP.
struck or touched or visited by (instr. or comp.), Kāv.; Pur.
warded off, repelled, MBh.; R.
rejected, repulsed, BhP.
disturbed, impeded, Kāv.; Pur.
a: विहत — p. p. 1 Struck completely, killed. --2 Hurt. --3 Opposed, impeded, resisted. --तः A Jaina temple.

m: वि-˚हति f. a stroke, blow, Bālar.
striking, killing, W.
prevention, removal, Bālar.
repulse, defeat, Ml.
वि-˚हति m. a friend, companion, W.
a: विहतिः — A friend, companion. --f. 1 Killing, striking. --2 Failure. --3 Defeat, rout.

m: वि-˚हवीय n. ‘containing the word विहव’, N. of the hymn, RV. x, 128.
वि-हव &c. See वि-√ ह्वे, p. 1004.
वि-हव m. invocation, RV.; AitBr.
वि-˚हव्या (आ), f. N. of partic. bricks, TS.
(scil. सूक्त) N. of RV. x, 128 (cf. ˚हवीय), TS.; Kāṭh.; Lāṭy.
वि-˚हव्य or वि-हव्य, mfn. to be invoked or invited or desired, RV.; AV.; VS.
वि-˚हव्य m. (with आङ्गिरस) N. of the supposed author of RV. x, 128; Anukr.
of a son of Varcas, MBh.
वि-√ हेठ् Caus. P. -हेठयति, to hurt, injure, Lalit.

m: वि-˚हेठ m. hurt, injury, ib.
a: विहेठः — 1 Hurt, injury. --2 Afflicting, harassing.

m: वि-˚हेठक mfn. hurting, injuring, an injurer, MBh.
a reviler, W.
a: विहेठकः — 1 An injurer. --2 A reviler, calumniator.

v: na॰ vi + heWa--BAve lyuw । 1 hiMsAyAM 2 mardane 3 viqambage medi॰ 4 vibADAyAM trikA॰ ।
m: वि-˚हेठन n. the act of hurting, injuring, distressing, afflicting &c., L.
a: विहेठनं — 1 Injuring, hurting. --2 Rubbing, grinding. --3 Afflicting. --4 Pain, sorrow, torment.

m: वि-√ हेल् Caus. Ā. -हेलयते, to vex, annoy, MBh. xiii, 6720 (B. -घातयते).

वि-√ हृ P. -हरति (rarely Ā.), to put asunder, keep apart, separate, open, RV.; AV.; Br.; ŚrS.; to distribute and transpose (verses or parts of verses), Br.; ŚrS.; to disperse (clouds, opp. to सं-√ हृ), Hariv.; (with तलात् तलम्) to shift, let pass from hand to hand, MBh.; to divide (also arithmetically), KātyŚr.; Gol.; to construct (in geom.), Śulbas.; to cut off, sever, MBh.; to extract from (abl.), ib.; to carry away, remove, Kāv.; Rājat.; to tear in pieces, lacerate, RV.; to move on, walk, ĀśvŚr.; to spend or pass (time), Gobh.; Mn.; MBh. &c.; to roam, wander through (acc.), MBh.; (esp.) to walk or roam about for pleasure, divert one's self, Gaut.; Mn.; MBh. &c. (with मृगयाम्, ‘to go about hunting’, R.); to shed (tears), Śak. : Desid. See वि-जिहीर्षा, ˚षु (p. 960, col. 3).
a: विहृ — {c1c} P. 1 To take away, seize away. --2 To remove, destroy. --3 To let fall, shed (as tears); as in बाष्पं विहरति. --4 To pass (as time). --5 To amuse, or divert oneself. sport, play; विहरति हरिरिह सरसवसंते Gīt. 1; गंधमादनवनं विहर्तुं गता V. 4; U. 3. 6. --6 To go in various directions. --7 To live. --8 To change, alternate.

m: वि—हृदय (वि-), n. want of courage, AV.

m: वि-हृत mfn. set or put asunder, distributed, disposed &c.
transposed, varied (as words or Pādas), ŚrS.
वि-हृत n. a walk, R.
hesitation, reluctance, bashful silence (one of the 10 Hāvas or feminine modes of indicating love), Daśar.; Sāh.
a: विहृत — p. p. 1 Sported, played. --2 Expanded. --तं 1 One of the ten modes of indicating love used by women; see S. D. 125, 146; (written विकृत also in this sense). --2 Sport, play.

m: वि-हृत—षोडशी f. N. of wk.

s: strI, viSezeRa haraRam । viSezeRa balAtkAraH । vipUrvvahfDAtoH ktipratyayena nizpannamidam ॥
m: वि-˚हृति f. expansion, increase, growth, Kir.
sport, pastime, pleasure, Nalod.
taking away, MW.
a: विहृतिः — f. 1 Removal, taking away. --2 Sport, pastime, pleasure. --3 Expansion.

m: वि-√ हिंस् P. -हिंसति, to injure severely, hurt, damage, Mn.; MBh. &c.: Caus. -हिंसयति id., MBh.
वि-˚हिंसा f. (MBh.; R.) id. (with gen. or ifc.)
वि-˚हिंसक mfn. injuring, hurting, harming (with gen. or ifc.), MBh.; R. &c.
वि-˚हिंसन n. (BhP.) id. (with gen. or ifc.)
वि-˚हिंस-ता f. the act of harming or injuring (with loc.), MBh.
वि-˚हिंसित mfn. injured, hurt, damaged &c., MBh.; R.
वि—हिंस्र See s.v.
वि-˚हिंस्र See अ-विहिंस्र.
वि-हि˚ताञ्जलि mfn. making a respectful obeisance, Śiś.
वि-हि˚तागस् mfn. one who has committed a fault, faulty, wicked, W.

v: tri॰ vi + DA--kta । 1 kfte viDinA 2 boDite ca ।
m: 1. वि—हित mfn. (for 2. see under वि-√ धा) improper, unfit, not good, W.
वि-हित See s.v.
2. वि-हित mfn. (fr., वि- √ 1. धा, p. 967; for 1. वि-हित See p. 953, col. 2) distributed, divided, apportioned, bestowed, supplied &c.
put in order, arranged, determined, fixed, ordained, ordered, RV. &c. &c.
prescribed, decreed, enjoined, GṛŚrS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
destined or meant for (nom.), MBh.
contrived, performed, made, accomplished, done, Mn.; MBh. &c.
supplied, endowed, furnished with or possessed of (instr.), MBh.; R. (cf. सु-विहित)
वि-हित n. an order, command, decree, Pañcat.
a: विहित — p. p. 1 Done, performed, made, acted. --2 Arranged, fixed, settled, appointed, determined. --3 Ordered, prescribed, decreed; Pt. 1. 201. --4 Framed, constructed. --5 Placed, deposited --6 Furnished with, possessed of. --7 Fit to be done. --8 Distributed, apportioned. (See धा with वि). --तं An order, a command, decree; परतो दवैविहितायत्तं Pt. 1.

m: वि-हित—दुर्ग-रचन mfn. one who has enjoined the building of a fortress, MW.
वि-हित—क्षण mfn. eager for the right moment, intent upon (अर्थम्), Vcar. (cf. कृत-क्ष्˚)
वि-हित—प्रतिषिद्ध mfn. enjoined and prohibited (-त्व n.), KātyŚr., Sch.
वि-हित—प्रतिषिद्ध—त्व n.
वि-हित—सेन m. N. of a prince, Kathās.
वि-हित—त्व n. the being enjoined or prescribed, prescription, direction, Hcat.
वि-हित—वत् mfn. one who has performed or undertaken, W.
वि-हित—वृत्ति mfn. one who is maintained or nourished by (instr.), Rājat.
वि-हित—यज्ञ mfn. performing sacrifices, Śak. (v.l. for वितत-य्˚)
वि-हि˚तेन्द्रिय mfn. possessed of one's senses, Bhaṭṭ.

s: strI, (vi + DA + ktin .) viDAnam । yaTA, -- “kzitivijitisTitivihitivrataratayaH paragatayaH । Uru ruruDurguruduDuvuryuDi kuravaH svamarikulam ॥” iti daRqI ॥
m: वि-˚हिति f. procedure, way of acting, AitBr.
action, performance, accomplishment, Kāvyād.; Bālar.
a: विहितिः — f. 1 Performance, doing, action. --2 Arrangement.

m: वि-˚हित्रिम mfn. done according to rule, Bhaṭṭ.
विह्लण &c. See बिल्हण.
वि-√ ह्मल् Caus. -ह्मलयति, ib.
वि-√ ह्नु Ā. -ह्नुते, Sch. on APrāt. i, 100.
वि—ह्रदिन् mfn. (perhaps) making pools, Kāṭh. xxiii, 6.
वि-√ ह्रु (cf. वि-√ ह्वृ below) P. -ह्रुणाति, to cause to deviate, turn aside, frustrate, spoil, RV.
वि-˚ह्रुत् f. a serpent-like animal, worm &c., VS.
वि-˚ह्रुत (वि-), mfn. crooked, dislocated, hurt, injured, RV.; AV.
वि-हुण्डन m. (√ हुण्ड्) N. of one of Śiva's attendants, L.
वि-√ हुर्छ् (or -हूर्छ्) P. -हूर्छति, to waddle, toddle, sway from one side to another (applied to a corpulent person's gait), ŚBr.; to stagger, totter, stumble, Kāṭh.
वि—हुत्-मत् mfn. presenting no offerings, RV. i, 134, 6
(Sāy. ‘offering, invoking’)
वि—हुत्-मती (अती), f. a special oblation, MW.
वि-ह्वारुक mfn. tumbling, falling, MaitrS.
वि-√ ह्वल् P. -ह्वलति, to shake or sway to and fro, tremble, be agitated or unsteady, stagger, MantraBr.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: विह्वल् — {c1c} P. To stagger, tremble, shake about; अंतर्भिन्नं भ्रमति हृदयं विह्वलत्यंगमंगं Māl. 5. 20.

m: वि-ह्व˚लाङ्ग mfn. (= ˚ल-तनु), MārkP.; Pañcat.
वि-ह्व˚लाक्ष mf(ई)n. (= ˚ल-लोचन), ib.
वि-ह्व˚लात्मन् mfn. (= ˚ल-चेतन), BhP.
विह्वली-कृत mfn. made confused or agitated, MW.
fused, liquid, ib.

s: tri, (vi + hvala + ac .) BayAdinABiBUtaH । svANgaDAraRASaktaH । tatparyyAyaH । viklavaH 2 । ityamaraH ॥ (yaTA, raGuH । 8 । 37 । “kzaRamAtrasaKIM sujAtayoH stanayostAmavalokya vihvalA । nimimIla narottamapriyA hftacandrA tamaseva kOmudI ॥”) vilInam । iti hemacandraH ॥
v: tri॰ vi + hvala--ac । 1 BayAdinA vyAkule amaraH । 2 vilIne ca hemaca॰ ।
m: वि-ह्वल mf(आ)n. agitated, perturbed, distressed, afflicted, annoyed (अम् ind.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
वि-ह्वल m. myrrh, L.
a: विह्वल — a. 1 Agitated, disquieted, perturbed, confused; R. 8. 37. --2 Overcome with fear, alarmed. --3 Delirious, beside oneself. --4 Afflicted, distressed; Bh. 3. 59; Ku. 4. 4. --5 Desponding. --6 Fused, liquid.

k.v: विक्लवो विह्वलः स्यात्तु विवशोऽरिष्टदुष्टधीः। कश्यः कश्यार्हे सन्नद्धे त्वाततायी वधोद्यते॥

m: वि-ह्वल—चेतन (MBh.) mfn. distressed in mind, low-spirited
वि-ह्वल—चेतस् (Kathās.) mfn. distressed in mind, low-spirited
वि-ह्वल—हृदय mfn. (= -चेतन), BhP.
वि-ह्वल—लोचन mfn. one who has unsteady or rolling eyes, MBh.; BhP.
वि-ह्वलम् ind.
वि-ह्वल—सालसाङ्ग mf(ई)n. one whose body is exhausted and languid, Caurap.
वि-ह्वल—ता f. agitation, perturbation, consternation, anxiety, MBh.
वि-ह्वल—तनु mfn. one whose body is exhausted by (comp.), Pañcat.
वि-ह्वल—त्व n. agitation, perturbation, consternation, anxiety, MBh.
वि-˚ह्वलित mfn. = ˚ह्वल, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
वि-˚ह्वलित—सर्वाङ्ग mfn. trembling with the whole body, MBh.
वि-ह्वरित See वि-√ ह्वृ.
वि-ह्वरित mfn. staggered, fallen (Vedic accord. to Kāś. on Pāṇ. vii, 2, 33).
वि-√ ह्वे Ā. -ह्वयते (cf. Pāṇ. i, 3, 30), to call in different places, call, invoke, vie in calling, contend for anything, RV.; TS.; Br.
वि-√ ह्वृ (cf. वि-√ ह्रु), to stagger, stumble, fall, TĀr. (cf. अ-विह्वरत्) : Caus. (only aor. Subj. -जिह्वरः), to cause to fall, overthrow, RV.
